findings.description: Using atoi silently treats invalid input as 0 and provides no overflow detection.
Potential overflow when converting large numbers to int.
recvfrom is called with NULL address parameters, so responses from any host are accepted. With UDP, this allows spoofed responses.
Raw UDP with no integrity/authentication or confidentiality.
Socket is never closed due to infinite loop and absence of a clean exit path.
